Berkeley vendors can no longer sell new fur apparel following a council vote Tuesday designed "to promote community awareness of animal welfare." Councilwoman Sophie Hahn's substitute motion—to allow the sale of cowhide with hair, and sheep or lambskin with fleece—passed 6–3.
